email_trigger_behavior_help.help:
Controls how the flow handles conversation threads.

**Only the first email**
• Triggers once for the initial email.
• Ignores any subsequent replies to that thread.

**Include new replies as well**
• Triggers for the initial email.
• Also triggers every time a new reply arrives in the conversation.

searchFields.subject_behavior_help.help:
Enter keywords to filter by subject.

**Matches ANY of your words:** If you enter "**Job Interview**", it will trigger if the subject contains "**Job**" OR "**Interview**".
• **Partial match is okay:** "**Bill**" matches "Internet **Bill**".
• **Capital letters don't matter:** "urgent" matches "URGENT".
